overview: Food and drinks restore Energy, Hydration and Sanity and can grant a temporary buff on top. Most recipes are learned from paper recipe blueprints found in the world (kitchens, settlements) and cooked at a Stove, Electric Stove, or the endgame Kitchen Set / Integrated Kitchen (see the Stations section). Many recipes support swapping in a 'Deviated' (mutated) version of an ingredient for a stronger or different bonus effect.
